extract_tasks: extract tasks from a scenario by filtering oracle run event log for agent user interface messages
extract_user_details: extract user contact details from a scenario contacts app and return the user contact object
extract_agent_events: extract and filter agent events from an environment event log sorted by time and turn index
topological_sort: perform topological sort on a graph dictionary of event IDs and their parent dependencies
run_oracle_mode: run a scenario in oracle mode using an environment and attach the oracle run event log
